notes: Account: TeraIndex Systems — platform provider for enterprise-scale semantic search (B2B SaaS).
Use case: massive-scale vector index for multi-tenant customers; primary flows = semantic search + reranking for search UX.
Scale target: 500M - 1B+ vectors by end of year; running mixed hot/warm index tiers; expect sustained ingest of 5M vectors/day during peak onboarding.
Embedding details: currently evaluating 1536-d embeddings (in-house FP16 encoders) and off-the-shelf 768/1536 models for quality/latency tradeoff.
Indexing topology ask: shard placement across regions, automated compaction, cold-tier object store integration (S3) for >12 month archival.
Latency SLOs: 95th percentile < 120ms for top-K ANN lookup; reranking (cross-encoder) end-to-end 95p < 250ms for web search UX.
Cost target: blended cost per query (ANN + rerank) goal <$0.001; looking for unit cost optimization recommendations (batching, quantization, cache hit strategies).
Architectural constraints: strict data residency for EU tenants; legal needs a template for residency and escrow. Legal review in progress.
Security: require SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS, audit logging retention 2+ years. SOC2 readiness is mandatory for procurement.
POC performed: Redwood Dedicated perf POC (topology with 8x A100 equiv nodes). Results: recall ok, but 95p latency spiky when concurrent rerank jobs run.
Quote from CTO on 2026-02-12 demo: "We need predictable tail latency not just average—our customers SLA will break otherwise."
Technical ask to Redwood: suggestions for batching windows, prefix/result caching, KV-cache for repeated queries, and automatic rerank gating when load spikes.
Optimize interest: quantization profiles, hybrid CPU/GPU fallback, smart routing by tenant to reduce cross-tenant noisiness.
Integrations: ingestion connectors (Kafka, S3, DB CDC) — ingestion reliability and backpressure handling are high priority.
Potential purchase: Dedicated cluster + Optimize consult; may convert to Private (VPC/on-prem) for regulated customers after initial deployment.
Risk notes: internal procurement timeline aligned to Q2 budget; urgent legal/data residency sign-off to make May close realistic.
